transcript:

Speaker B: That sounds perfect. Is breakfast included?
Speaker A: Yes ma'am, buffet breakfast from seven to ten.
Speaker B: Good. And is there a prayer mat in the room or can we request one?
Speaker A: We can arrange that for you right away, ma'am. I will have housekeeping send it up.
Speaker B: Thank you. That's very kind.
Speaker A: Room 712, seventh floor. Lift is on your right. Enjoy your stay, Mrs. Sheikh.
Speaker B: Jazakallah. Thank you very much.

I practice for just ten minutes every day. And this app explains everything to me in my language in such an easy way.]

Speaker B: এক কাপ চায়ের থেকেও কম। [Less than a cup of tea.]
Speaker C: সত্যি বলছো? তাহলে তো আমি আজ থেকেই try করি। [Are you telling the truth? Then I will try it from today.]
